content: Bactroban Cream, which contains 2% mupirocin calcium, is formulated with the dihydrate crystalline calcium hemi-salt of the antibiotic mupirocin. Chemically, mupirocin calcium is described as (αE, 2S, 3R, 4R, 5S)-5-tetrahydro-3,4-dihydroxy-β-methyl-2H-pyran-2-crotonic acid, esterified with 9-hydroxynonanoic acid, in the form of a calcium salt (2:1) dihydrate. The cream contains 3.6% mupirocin free acid in an oil-and-water-based emulsion. The inactive ingredients in the formulation include benzyl alcohol, cetomacrogol 1000, cetyl alcohol, mineral oil, phenoxyethanol, purified water, stearyl alcohol, and xanthan gum.
